title: Launch Converaid with a distinct desktop identity
summary: English requirement summary of earlier user requests: Brand the desktop application Converaid with original logo, application and tray assets, recognizable toolbar and panel, main-toolbar taskbar visibility, existing-profile compatibility, and no upstream auto-update feed unless an explicit fork feed is configured.
acceptance: WHEN Converaid opens THE SYSTEM SHALL display its original brand assets and application name in the toolbar, panel, tray and window titles, with the main toolbar visible in the taskbar.
WHEN an existing profile is present THE SYSTEM SHALL retain its local settings and credentials through the established compatible storage identity.
WHEN no explicit update feed is configured THE SYSTEM SHALL skip auto-updates instead of downloading an upstream application.

manualChecks.result: Existing verified work reported by the release owner: complete suite 257 passed and 1 skipped, desktop/390 px local UI smoke passed, and every generated image inspected. Source package was already built by the release owner; this bookkeeping task made no new package or delivery claim.

scope.why: Desktop application identity, packaging and update feeds are independent of coding assistant.

captured.words: English requirement summary of earlier user requests: Brand the desktop application Converaid with original logo, application and tray assets, recognizable toolbar and panel, main-toolbar taskbar visibility, existing-profile compatibility, and no upstream auto-update feed unless an explicit fork feed is configured.

research.done: Inspected the Electron window, tray, package and updater integration. Kept the established storage/app identity for existing-profile compatibility, introduced original Converaid artwork and visible names, and required an explicit CONVERAID_UPDATE_URL feed rather than inheriting upstream updates. Evidence: app/package.json, electron/main.ts, tray.ts, updater.ts, windows/WindowManager.ts and docs/converaid-branding.md at c145803.

design.done: The release owner inspected every original Converaid logo, ICO and tray image and the rendered toolbar/panel screenshots. Desktop 1440 px and approximately 390 px UI smoke passed. The toolbar remains taskbar-visible while auxiliary windows remain excluded, matching the requested desktop discoverability.

security.done: Branding preserves compatible profile and credential storage and does not copy secrets into assets or metadata. The packaged app only starts update checks when an explicit fork feed is supplied; updater tests cover the absent-feed boundary. Original image assets and local UI fixtures add no paid calls. An unchanged upstream account/billing error-display issue is recorded separately as a low-severity finding.
